newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates finish sharply higher.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates finish sharply higher.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed sharply higher on Tuesday on tight liquidity, but dealers expected the rates to soften on Wednesday after the central bank injected funds into the banking system to ease liquidity.
The overnight interbank rate ended at 5.445 percent against Monday's 5.264 close, with the 30-day commercial paper up sharply to 5.50 percent against 5.10-5.25.
The central bank on Tuesday injected T$4 billion worth of funds into the banking system through open market operations.
The bond market remained slugglish, dealers said the market would move to a consolidation phase due to the lack of market-boosting news.
